title: Strategy multiplier scales every leg's lots (G-20-1)
reference_behaviour: A Multiplier list (1 to N) multiplies all lots; with 2, every leg doubles and max profit, max loss, premium and margin double.
ours: REQ-076 AC-4 (multiplier 1 to 50, back to 1 restores base lots) is not built on main; it exists only on branch W-126.
